emails_auth_ignore: If you didn’t ask for this, you can safely ignore this email.
emails_auth_link_fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:
emails_auth_reason_account: You’re receiving this email because of activity on your SOTF Mods account.
emails_auth_verify_subject: Confirm your email for SOTF Mods
emails_auth_verify_preview: Confirm your address to publish, comment and review.
emails_auth_verify_body: Welcome to SOTF Mods. Confirm this address to publish mods, comment and write reviews.
emails_auth_link_expiry_hours: This link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
emails_auth_reset_preview: Use this link to choose a new password.
emails_auth_reset_body: A password reset was requested for your account.
emails_auth_reset_expiry: This link works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
emails_auth_password_changed_subject: Your SOTF Mods password was changed
emails_auth_password_changed_preview: If this wasn’t you, secure your account.
emails_auth_password_changed_body: The password of your account was changed on {when} (UTC).
emails_auth_password_changed_not_you: Wasn’t you? Reset your password right away and review your active sessions.
emails_auth_email_change_subject: Confirm your new email for SOTF Mods
emails_auth_email_change_preview: Confirm the new address to finish the change.
emails_auth_email_change_body: You asked to use {email} for your SOTF Mods account. Confirm it to finish the change.
emails_auth_email_notice_subject: The email of your SOTF Mods account is being changed
emails_auth_email_notice_preview: The change only happens once the new address is confirmed.
emails_auth_email_notice_body: On {when} (UTC) someone asked to change the email of your account to {email}. Nothing changes until the new address is confirmed.
emails_auth_email_notice_not_you: Wasn’t you? Change your password now and review your sessions.
emails_auth_export_subject: Your SOTF Mods data export is ready
emails_auth_export_preview: Download a copy of everything linked to your account.
emails_auth_export_body: Your export is a ZIP file with every record linked to your account, as JSON.
emails_auth_export_expiry: The link expires on {when} (UTC). You can request a new export after that.
emails_auth_deletion_subject: Your SOTF Mods account will be deleted
emails_auth_deletion_preview: You can still cancel the deletion.
emails_auth_deletion_body: Your account will be deleted on {when} (UTC). Until then you can cancel it from your settings and everything stays as it is.
emails_auth_deletion_mode_keep: Your mods will stay published without your name.
emails_auth_deletion_cancelled_subject: Your SOTF Mods account will not be deleted
emails_auth_deletion_cancelled_body: The deletion was cancelled on {when} (UTC). Your account stays as it is.
emails_auth_deleted_subject: Your SOTF Mods account was deleted
emails_auth_deleted_preview: Your personal data has been erased.
emails_auth_deleted_body: Your personal data has been erased. Comments and reviews remain under “Deleted user”. Thank you for being part of SOTF Mods.
emails_auth_new_login_subject: New login to your SOTF Mods account
emails_auth_new_login_body: A login to your account was recorded on {when} (UTC) from a device or country we had not seen before.
emails_auth_new_login_not_you: Wasn’t you? Reset your password right away and review your active sessions.
emails_auth_security_change_subject: A security setting of your SOTF Mods account changed
emails_auth_security_change_preview: If this wasn’t you, secure your account.
emails_auth_security_change_totp_enabled: Two-factor authentication with an authenticator app was turned on for your account on {when} (UTC).
emails_auth_security_change_totp_disable: Two-factor authentication with an authenticator app was turned off for your account on {when} (UTC).
emails_auth_security_change_recovery_cod: The recovery codes of your account were replaced on {when} (UTC). The old codes no longer work.
emails_auth_security_change_passkey_adde: A passkey was added to your account on {when} (UTC).
emails_auth_security_change_passkey_remo: A passkey was removed from your account on {when} (UTC).
emails_auth_security_change_not_you: Wasn’t you? Reset your password right away and review your active sessions.
